scope: Only the recorded non-root read-only fictional-household container with application-created database and owner-verified application-generated recovery snapshots. No arbitrary SQL, uploaded/untrusted database/WAL/changeset, public deployment, or changed source/dependencies. Raw findings retained; scoped reachability decisions are not vendor fixes.

CVE-2026-76642.reason: The vulnerable mount CLI is removed. Non-root, zero capabilities and no-new-privileges are verified. No mount/helper operation is exposed by the service.

CVE-2026-78408.reason: The vulnerable nsenter CLI is removed. No privileged cgroup/namespace operator or inherited cgroup descriptor is used by the service.

CVE-2026-78409.reason: The vulnerable mount CLI is removed. The service has no fstab/subdirectory mount interface and runs without capabilities or privilege escalation.

CVE-2026-78410.reason: The vulnerable mount CLI is removed. No SUID mount or fstab-controlled bind mount is available through the service.

CVE-2026-54369.reason: libacl is not loaded by the service. No ACL pathname function or privileged filesystem operator is exposed; UID 10001, zero capabilities and no-new-privileges are verified.

CVE-2025-69720.reason: The affected analyze_string function belongs to the infocmp CLI; that executable is removed. ncurses library package matches are retained in the raw report.

CVE-2026-16742.reason: The affected systemd-homed daemon is absent. libsystemd/libudev are not loaded by the service; no homed-managed user or system-group API exists.

CVE-2026-9538.reason: The Perl interpreter entry points are removed. The service is Python and exposes no Perl archive extraction route.

CVE-2026-119371.reason: Requires attacker-supplied SQL or an untrusted database view. All ten SQL statements are constant and inventoried; there is no SQL/database upload interface. Only application-generated fictional state and verified owner snapshots are in scope.

CVE-2026-119372.reason: Requires FTS3/FTS4 MATCH/snippet queries. The exact fixed-SQL application has only household_state and no FTS queries; the release gate rejects any new MATCH/VIRTUAL SQL surface.

CVE-2026-119373.reason: Requires FTS5 detail=none and a prefix MATCH query. The exact application has no virtual table, FTS, or MATCH interface; new such SQL fails the source inventory gate.

CVE-2026-119374.reason: Requires an untrusted corrupt FTS5 database. No database file upload exists; only application-created household_state and hash-verified owner-generated snapshots are in scope. Untrusted recovery inputs remain excluded.

CVE-2026-119375.reason: Requires an attacker-provided database/WAL. No database/WAL upload or SQL interface exists. Only application-created fictional state and owner-verified application-generated snapshots are in scope.

CVE-2026-119376.reason: Requires attacker-provided SQL or an untrusted database view. The ten statements are constant and include no COLLATE operation; uploaded databases and arbitrary SQL are excluded.

CVE-2026-119379.reason: Requires a supplied SQLite session changeset. The source exposes no changeset API or upload, and the fixed-SQL state store uses a single ordinary household_state table.
